title: Qantas AmEx Ultimate: 70,000 Qantas Points with $5,000 Spend in 3 Months, $450 Travel Credit, $450 Annual Fee @ American Express
body:
Deal: Qantas AmEx Ultimate: 70,000 Qantas Points with $5,000 Spend in 3 Months, $450 Travel Credit, $450 Annual Fee @ American Express

[cook99] Finally I've hit the 18 months and eligible, but man sucks Amex joined all the rest on the split bonus over 2 years… $450 for 70,000 hurts a bit compared to few years back
[starburstyellow] I was in same boat, waited extra 2 months for 20 months just to be sure.
I got rejected, when I asked why got told due to credit card application inquries.
I am a churner (apply about 2-3 a year).
Amex is definitely no longer the company that would have previously approve for churners. YMMV.
[Crowing] Same points bonus available for those that sign up via referral link to the Qantas ultimate CC…
[FrugalDealSeeker] Good luck most churners aren't getting approved.
[starburstyellow] Yup I'm one of them. Never had a rejection for the last 10+ years till the amex recently. They used to turn a blind eye on this kind of thing (have applied amex 3 times successfully in the last 10 years).
[FrugalDealSeeker] You’re not getting Amex again. I’m 100% sure my wife and I are also blacklisted for life.
[spiff] I've been churning for over 10 years. Been rejected by Amex in 2024 but got approved in 2025. With the rejection rates seemingly very high, it's no longer one I will churn, and will just enjoy the decent points earning rate.
[juzzayy] @spiff: can you share your specific dates when you previously held an amex, got rejected, and then finally got approved?
I'm in a similar situation and I wanna compare # of months :s
[AusGaz] Looks like it's the same standard offer that card holders have.
Your friend will receive
Up to 120,000 bonus Qantas Points. That's 70,000 bonus Qantas Points when they apply online by 17 November 2026 for the Qantas American Express Ultimate Card using your referral link, are approved and spend $5,000 on eligible purchases in the first 3 months from Card approval date. Plus, earn an additional 50,000 bonus Qantas Points when they spend a further $5,000 on eligible purchases within the first 3 months of their second year of Card membership. New American Express Card Members only. T&Cs apply.
i.e. Use the ozbargain referral links ​😉
[socheap] anything similar around for virgin?
Is this as good as things get for an Amex personal card?
[VladImpaler] Not as many points as the Qantas offer:
The Offer:
If you hold an American Express Velocity Platinum Card, your reward when your friend is approved will be 30,000 Velocity Points provided your friend applies online via the referral link by 8 September 2026 and so long as your Account is in good standing. Your friend will receive up to 100,000 bonus Velocity Points when they apply online by 8 September 2026 via your referral link, are approved, and meet the following criteria - Your friend will receive 70,000 bonus Velocity Points when they spend $5,000 or more on eligible purchases on their new American Express Velocity Platinum Card within the first 3 months from the Card approval date. To receive an additional 30,000 bonus Velocity Points, your friend will need to remain on the American Express Velocity Platinum Card after the first year and spend a minimum of $1 on the Card within 90 days of paying the 2nd year Annual Card Fee. Annual Card Fee is $440. Offer only available to new American Express Card Members. T&Cs apply.
[OzWaster] the virgin offer is marginally better.
(10k or 20k extra with https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/963035 )
click through to the amex offer from the virgin site to get
75k in year 1.
25k in year 2.
so 85 or 95k points in year 1 (vs 70k on the qantas card), similar fee and return domestic flight
[jayzwalker] if you had an amex card issued in your name but as a corporate card - does that count as holding a card in the last 18 months?
[poiterbad] In the past, corporate card doesn't count as being a member. I've had one for about 10 years and claimed the amex bonus 4 times so far
[illusion99] Just double check with Amex because they change policies all the time. What was true once might not be true now.
[Ghogger] Pro tip
You can book a refundable flight with the $450 travel credit, cancel the flight within 24 hours, and you’ll get the $450 refunded to your credit card. Completely negates the $450 fee, you’re welcome :)
[timhn] Will this work during weekend? I vaguely remember seen somewhere that mentioned do this during business hours.
[Save 50 Cent] I’m pretty sure it has to be within the same day NOT 24 hrs. So cancel before midnight. And that applies to any ticket. Does not have to a refundable one.
So, make a booking on qantas (thru amex website) for as close to $450 as you can (slightly more and could be for more than one ticket). Cancel a couple of hours later.
Worked for me for three years so far.
[OzWaster] is the cancellation done online or do you need to call them?
[jeffr] how long do you need to wait after the booking to cancel it? (It just worked - waited 2 minutes after making the booking before I could cancel)
[kanade] Does this work with Explorer card as well?
[nategasm] Yup did this just last month so still works (cancel before midnight, not 24 hours)
[Fuzor] +++
If it weren't for this, paying $450 every year for this card mightn't be worth it. The main benefit is the low min credit limit, periodic Amex cashback, the comp travel insurance and (only) if you're in Melb or Syd, the Amex lounges.
And the lounges in Australia are run by Plaza, small space, no windows and average food. Drinks are nice.
[sim777] Can confirm I have successfully done this 2 yrs in a row for this card. Make sure you book your flight through the Amex portal
[jeffr] Wow thanks for the tip that has got to be one of the best one this year !
"The total price of your booking is lower than the Travel Credit amount, therefore your Travel Credit cannot be redeemed towards this booking. Please check your Travel Credit Terms & Conditions for further information, which can be viewed by clicking on the Travel Credit link on the top right of the page."
[asiangeek] im new into this, if i want to applying and get approved, how they will charged the annual fee? im still a bit confused on step by step to negates the fee that you mention
[silverham] They add the $450 annual fee as extra charge to your credit card account in your first month.
Annual benefits include $450 credit towards a $450+ Qantas branded flight which you tick a box when booking via the amex travel agent portal not direct. Full flight cost is charged but you get $450 cashback within a few days.
People have reported a hack/design feature where if you cancel within a few hours on the day of booking, the flight charge gets removed (like a credit authorisation does) but the $450 cashback stays, so you can rebook your flight at your leisure, but if don't rebook, it effectively makes the card "free".
[poiterbad] I think the NAB deal is better at 100k Qantas points off a $5k spend in 90 days, plus $250 cashback and $100 off annual fee (from $420 to $320). NAB deal for reference
Essentially $70 for 100k Qantas Points. The travel credit for amex here is good but if you don't need it…
[djc] I had a Qantas Money Credit Card that was managed by NAB as the financial institution.
I assume I would still be eligible for the NAB Deal?
[sydonk] Any churners able to get approved by Amex lately?
[starburstyellow] Not sure if Feb counts as lately, but I got rejected in Feb 26 (see above for bit of history of me waiting 20 months). On same day of rejection phone call, applied HSBC star alliance card and approved for $20K limit. Go figure.
[Mums Poop Sock] "spend $5,000 on eligible purchases" i have skimmed the T&C's and can't understand what they deem as eligible.
[Mums Poop Sock] I have a Square tap payment device. Could I just charge myself $5000 in taps and be rewarded with the points?
[Save 50 Cent] Technically yes.. but it will definitely be a red flag and they might deny you the points.. plus you have to cop the fees.
With the price of fuel and groceries, surely you can spend $5000 in 3 months? You can buy gift cards to help you get there.
[Fizzydrink] Will also show as 5k income on square reporting if youre wanting to keep income low
[Checkmate3023] the age of churners is truely over if this is what is on offer
[Davbar24] Good card, since getting this about 6 months ago I've earnt around 130,000 points. The flights via amex travel are a little more expensive when using the $450. I was flying anyway so actually used it although as some mention you can use the "hack".
Also award bonus points on spends at qantas which is great when Qantas do 10 points per dollar on apple gift cards etc.I'll get my 30,000 points on the 2nd year then look at other options but seriously considering keeping this.
[Save 50 Cent] It is essentially a free credit card. Definitely keep it. You might never be approved for it again.
[tanned] I haven’t been Primary card holder in the last 18 months, but have always had one as Additional holder, I cannot see the terms excluding that. Has anyone been in the same shoes?
[nadesico123] I have Amex Platinum and added my wife as an additional card holder. Before I send her a referral for the Platinum card (as a primary card holder), I called AMEX to confirm if I can do that and still eligible for referral points.
AMEX told me that as long as she never had the card as a primary holder, I can refer her and get referral points upon approval.
[BargainLtd] Bugger will be 18th months on November 24th so looks like I will just miss out.
I know no guarantees with Amex and churners but still a shame cant try.
[juzzayy] i had this Qantas AmEx Ultimate in the past, opened in Feb 2024 and i closed it (churned <1year held) around Jan-Feb 2025.
1 year later in Jan 2026, i applied and got rejected for AmEx Explorer; most likely for churning indicators or whatever, unlikely to be financial reasons/my equifax looks perfect. They didn't give a reason, I called and they were vague and said that's all we can say.
I'm waiting until about early-mid August 2026 to try again, which will be past the 18 month mark (and coincidentally it makes me re-eligible for this deal).
TBH i don't even churn these days but I actually really want an AmEx to hold long-term now for travel reasons + US credit score builder… Feelsbad I hope they grant me lol
